import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', dtype=str)
mutations = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', dtype=str)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Define nonsynonymous mutation classes and filter
nonsyn = [
    'Missense_Mutation', 'Nonsense_Mutation', 'Splice_Site',
    'Frame_Shift_Del', 'Frame_Shift_Ins', 'In_Frame_Del',
    'In_Frame_Ins', 'Nonstop_Mutation', 'Translation_Start_Site'
]
mut_ns = mutations[mutations['Variant_Classification'].isin(nonsyn)]

# 3. Count nonsynonymous mutations per patient and compute TMB
tmb = mut_ns.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='mut_count')
tmb['TMB'] = tmb['mut_count'] / 30.0

# 4. Prepare CD274 expression
# strip version suffix
expr.index = expr.index.str.split('.').str[0]
# extract CD274 (ENSG00000120217)
if 'ENSG00000120217' not in expr.index:
    raise KeyError('CD274 Ensembl ID not found in expression data')
cd274 = expr.loc['ENSG00000120217']

# 5. Map samples to patients and average expression
samples = cd274.index.to_series()
patient_ids = samples.str[:12]
expr_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'sample_barcode': samples.values,
    'patient_id': patient_ids.values,
    'CD274_expression': cd274.values.astype(float)
})
expr_patient = expr_df.groupby('patient_id')['CD274_expression'].mean().reset_index()

# 6. Merge TMB and expression
df = pd.merge(tmb[['patient_id','TMB']], expr_patient, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# Drop missing
df = df.dropna(subset=['TMB','CD274_expression'])

# 7. Descriptive statistics
desc = df[['TMB','CD274_expression']].agg(['count','mean','std']).T
print("Descriptive statistics for TMB and CD274 expression:")
print(desc)

# 8. Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(df['TMB'], df['CD274_expression'])
print(f"\nSpearman correlation: rho = {rho:.3f}, p-value = {pval:.4f}")

# 9. Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.regplot(
    x='TMB', y='CD274_expression', data=df,
    scatter_kws={'alpha':0.6}, lowess=True, line_kws={'color':'red'}
)
plt.xlabel('Tumor Mutational Burden (mutations per Mb)')
plt.ylabel('CD274 (PD-L1) Expression (log2 FPKM+0.001)')
plt.title('Correlation between TMB and PD-L1 Expression in Melanoma')
# annotate
plt.text(
    0.05, 0.95,
    f"Spearman rho = {rho:.3f}\np = {pval:.4f}",
    transform=plt.gca().transAxes,
    verticalalignment='top', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8)
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
